sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Inder Pal Singh Tomar,Anjali Singh Tomer Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
No one has put in appearance on behalf of the applicant even on the revised call.
Sri Deepak Mishra, learned A.G.A. is present.

By moving this application, the prayer is made to quash non bailable warrant dated 25.07.2022 issued by the Additional District and Session Judge, Court No.11, Ghaziabad in S.T. No.616/ 2013,
State Versus Nasibu and others, arising out of Case Crime No.692/ 2009, under Sections 270, 272,
273 I.P.C. and 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, Police Station Massoorie, District Ghaziabad, against the applicant.

entities.text: Additional District and Session Judge, Court No.11, Ghaziabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant is absent.
Otherwise also, this Court is not a proper forum to quash non bailable warrant against the applicant.
The application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. dismissed in non-prosecution.
